title: U3c (j) (2.16) CALIBRATION: the 0213 14-19% under-prediction was the (2.16) epsilon prefactor - eps_q(a,b) from the count identity #{0<t<h:(t+a,q)=1} = (phi/q)h + eps equals -1 for EVERY h >= 2 in the h-sum when a is odd, INCLUDING the diagonal class h=4,8.. (the 0213 rule had diagonal alpha^{+1}, off alpha^0); with eps = -1 on all four cells the (2.16) integral (960-pt, D_0+D_1+D_2 exact) reproduces the paper's own p.15 table to +0.64/+0.51/+0.47/+0.41% (diag) and -0.38/-0.34/-0.28/-0.25% (off), signed and decaying = the paper's discarded O(loglog/L) band (G2a PASS <= 0.7%); vs the actual measured counts +1.26%..+0.76% / -0.81%..-0.55%; R2 (diag eps=0) leaves -7..-9.6% (rejected); the OLD rule reproduces the original -18.84%/-7.77% exactly. LADDER: at the calibrated integrand S_full/S_data (k<3 + |A|+|T|=3 terms) = 0.9616 @ 1e7 then UNIFORMLY 1.050-1.052 over 1e8..1e13 (8 scales); S_sim/S_data ~ 0.63-0.69: the paper-deferred k=3 machinery explains ~95% of the measured U3c residual at a uniform 5% excess (named: k>=4 + higher O(loglog) D-terms, next step (j2))
verdict: the (2.16) instrument is CALIBRATED: eps = -1 (sum-consistent counting identity, all four q=4 cells) closes the 0213 deficit to the paper's own O(loglog/L) band, and the |A|+|T| = 3 machinery - which the paper bounds away and defers - is measured at finite H and explains ~95% of the measured U3c residual S(X) at a uniform 1.05x over 1e8..1e13 (right scale shape; the constant excess is named k>=4 / higher discarded D-terms). No RH claim; flank work that turns the U3c residual from 'unexplained at scale' into 'explained to a uniform 5% by the paper's own deferred terms'.
next: (j2) if the flank is revisited: the k>=4 density terms or the explicit O(loglog) D-terms to close the uniform 5%; otherwise the flank stands calibrated
